what_it_tests: isotropic, 5 equivalent 1H + 4 equivalent 14N, Lorentzian, Breit-Rabi on equivalent-nucleus F spins
note: Range automatic; stored data.x 333.913..359.098, 2000 points (Exp.nPoints = 2000). Explicit names 1H and 14N (single isotopes). garlic splits each equivalent group into total-F spins (equivcouple: 5x1/2 -> F 5/2 x1, 3/2 x4, 1/2 x5; 4x1 -> F 4 x1, 3 x3, 2 x6, 1 x6, 0 x3), solves Breit-Rabi per F, and adds the two groups' shifts (no cross terms between groups). garlic (no fast motion) builds the spectrum with Opt.AccumMethod='binning': makespec(...,'round') snaps each line to the NEAREST grid point, then convolves with a sampled lineshape. An analytic-line simulator cannot reproduce the snapping, so the reference itself carries a grid error. Measured: that model with analytic lines differs by 1.4e-1 of max (dx = 0.0126 mT vs FWHM 0.1 mT); with nearest-grid snapping it reproduces the reference to 1.4e-12. Treating the 5 (4) nuclei as independent instead of F spins gives 2.2e-1.
